findings.documented: Every request must carry the API key as a query parameter: GET /v1/listings?api_key=IVY26-XXXXXXXXXXXX.
findings.actual: Passing api_key as a query parameter returns HTTP 401 with detail 'send your key in the X-API-Key request header, not as a query parameter'. Key must be passed in X-API-Key request header.
findings.how_found: Called endpoints with api_key query parameter and inspected HTTP 401 error response body.
findings.impact: All API requests formatted per documentation fail with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

findings.documented: Returns token object with field 'token', 'expires_in': 86400 (24h), user object with email and name, and states no refresh flow exists.
findings.actual: Returns access token under field name 'access_token', expires_in is 900 seconds (15 minutes), user object lacks 'name', and response includes 'refresh_token' and 'refresh_url': '/auth/refresh'.
findings.how_found: Executed POST /auth/login with demo credentials and inspected JSON response structure.
findings.impact: Frontend looking for data.token or expecting 24-hour expiration fails to authenticate and fails to refresh expiring sessions.

findings.documented: Invalidates the current token server side.
findings.actual: Does not invalidate token server-side; returns note that tokens are stateless JWTs and must be discarded client-side. Issued bearer token remains valid for API requests after logout.
findings.how_found: Called POST /auth/logout and then successfully made authenticated requests using the logged-out token.
findings.impact: Security vulnerability if applications rely on server-side token revocation upon user logout.

findings.documented: Every collection endpoint takes page (1-indexed, default 1) and limit (default 20, max 200). Collection responses include page_size.
findings.actual: The page query parameter is quietly ignored by the server. Pagination requires offset parameter (0-indexed record offset). Page limit is hard-capped at 50, and page_size is null in metadata.
findings.how_found: Tested page=1 vs page=2 and received identical results; tested offset=50 and received the second page of results.
findings.impact: Page-based navigation fails to fetch subsequent pages unless offset parameter is used.

findings.documented: Response metadata total reports 3967 total listings.
findings.actual: Response metadata total reports 3967 listings, but paging via offset to the end retrieves 4100 records in total.
findings.how_found: Paged past reported total 3967 until results array became empty at offset 4100.
findings.impact: Client applications stopping at reported total miss 133 valid listing records.

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are in rupees as integers.
findings.actual: price_min and price_max are floating-point numbers expressed in Lakhs (or Crores when >= 1.0), e.g. 67.7 represents 67.7 Lakhs (6,770,000 INR) and 3.78 represents 3.78 Crores (37,800,000 INR).
findings.how_found: Inspected price_min and price_max values across /v1/projects and compared against actual listing prices.
findings.impact: Project prices rendered directly to users appear off by a factor of 100,000 or 10,000,000.

findings.documented: Returns active sale listings in your city. Inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server side.
findings.actual: Returns both active and inactive/withdrawn listings. 867 of 4100 retrievable listings have is_live set to false.
findings.how_found: Inspected is_live boolean field across all retrieved records from /v1/listings.
findings.impact: App displaying raw records shows inactive and withdrawn properties to users unless frontend filters by is_live === true.

findings.documented: Timestamps are ISO 8601, UTC, Z suffix, everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: posted_at timestamps in /v1/listings lack the Z suffix and timezone offset (e.g. '2026-01-19T12:56:00').
findings.how_found: Parsed posted_at field across listing records.
findings.impact: Date parsers assuming UTC offset with missing Z suffix may misinterpret local IST time as UTC.

findings.documented: All listing attributes describe physical properties.
findings.actual: Contains corrupt records with physically impossible data such as negative prices, bedroom = 0, carpet_area > super_built_up_area, or floor > total_floors.
findings.how_found: Audited field constraints across all 4100 listing records.
findings.impact: Displays impossible property data (e.g. 0 bedrooms, negative price) on listing detail pages.

findings.documented: posted_by_contact is the seller's verified contact number.
findings.actual: Multiple non-genuine / lead-gen listings exist where identical phone numbers are reused across distinct properties with multiple fake agent/agency names or rental prices listed as sale prices.
findings.how_found: Grouped listings by posted_by_contact and detected mismatched seller names and rental prices under Rs 1 Lakh.
findings.impact: Users contacting sellers reach lead-gen agents or fake listing contacts.

findings.documented: total_listings is recomputed whenever a listing is added or withdrawn, so it always agrees with GET /v1/listings?project_id=...
findings.actual: total_listings reported in /v1/projects disagrees with actual listing count in /v1/listings for 336 out of 460 projects.
findings.how_found: Compared project.total_listings against count of listings matching project_id.
findings.impact: Project detail pages report inaccurate available inventory counts.

findings.documented: GET /v1/analytics/summary returns pre-computed aggregates for your city.
findings.how_found: Sent GET request to /v1/analytics/summary with valid auth headers.
findings.impact: Insights / analytics dashboard cannot rely on server summary and must compute aggregates client-side.

findings.actual: GET /v1/listing/{id} (singular listing) returns 404 Not Found. The working path is plural: GET /v1/listings/{id}.
findings.impact: Navigation to listing detail using documented singular URL path fails.

findings.documented: GET /v1/listings/{listing_id}/similar returns up to ten comparable listings.
findings.how_found: Sent GET request to /v1/listings/MAG-4001518/similar and received 404.
findings.impact: Similar listings feature strips fail to load from server.

findings.documented: GET /v1/favourites, POST /v1/favourites, and DELETE /v1/favourites/{id} for saved listings.
findings.actual: All /v1/favourites endpoints return HTTP 404 Not Found.
findings.how_found: Sent GET, POST, DELETE requests to /v1/favourites and received 404.
findings.impact: Saved listings must be managed and persisted on the client side.

findings.documented: Not mentioned in documentation. Doc states 'There is no refresh flow'.
findings.actual: POST /auth/refresh exists and accepts refresh_token to issue a new access_token.
findings.how_found: Discovered refresh_url in POST /auth/login response and tested POST /auth/refresh.
findings.impact: Allows silent token renewal when 15-minute access token expires.

findings.documented: Supports sort_by (price, carpet_area, posted_at, bedroom) and order (asc, desc).
findings.actual: Sorting by price performs string/lexicographical sort or incorrect numerical order for negative prices, returning negative values first on desc order.
findings.how_found: Passed sort_by=price&order=desc and inspected order of returned prices.
findings.impact: Sorting listings by price fails to present correctly ordered results.

findings.documented: Each listing corresponds to exactly one physical property.
findings.actual: Multiple listing records with distinct listing_ids exist for the exact same physical property (identical locality, apartment_name, floor, carpet_area, bhk, and facing_direction).
findings.how_found: Grouped listings by physical property attributes.
findings.impact: Duplicate property cards appear in search results.
